caption: A new world: the top bar at ×1, running, the slow-down on
Paused through the bar: Play, Paused, one step taken
Running again, the Sun-like star dropped at the centre
200 steps through the real loop
Rung key 5: the fifth numbered rung, ×10, in accent
The slow-down checkbox cleared
Rung key 0: Max, the readout showing the running speed
World edge: Bounce back chosen in the bar, paused
World edge: Leave for good chosen again, paused
Left panel: Heat chosen, in accent
Left panel: Iron chosen in the element list
The brush back: two cells of iron painted far from the star, one step taken
Left panel: the Density view chosen, in accent
Right click on the star: the right panel reads its stage, mass, fate, age, temperatures
The pointer on the star's centre: the right panel's Cell inspector reads its mix, temperature, density and speed
The pointer moved off the world (cell 700, 500): the Cell inspector is back to its «Hover over a cell» line
The Massive preset at its supergiant (step 768), paused, in Glow at the default 3,000 K
Glow toned down: full brightness at 100 million K (the capture action glow_white)
Glow's Reset: back to 3,000 K, the world as in the default Glow step
The same star in Heat over its default range
Heat after Fit to view: the range found from the star's own temperatures
The same star zoomed to 8 around its centre (the capture action zoom): each cell 16 px, the legend and the hint where they were
Zoom back to 1, then a Sun-like star dropped by the panel's path at cell (80, 80), beside the supergiant
A Sun-like star armed and dropped at cell (10, 10), too near the edge: the refusal on screen, the preset still armed, the world as it was
